# cocoapods

<!-- The reference table below this banner is regenerated by `make generate`. Handwritten prose below the table lives in internal/support/prose/. -->

This page explains how Bomly builds a dependency graph for `cocoapods` projects: the detector chain it runs, what that chain needs, and what it can report.

| Property | Value |
| --- | --- |
| Package manager | `cocoapods` |
| Ecosystem | `swift` |
| Detector chain | `cocoapods-detector`, `syft-detector` |
| Evidence patterns | `Podfile.lock`, `Podfile` |
| Multi-module resolution | No |
| Install-first support | No |
| Remediation hints | None |
| Commands the chain may run | The Syft fallback is built in; the lite build runs an external `syft` from `PATH` instead. |
